name: 20817 · Bethesda, MD
findings: ZIP 20817 (Bethesda) has 322 nonprofit organizations. 135 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 121 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20817 (Bethesda) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 20817 (Bethesda) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 121 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.
